title: Prince de Conti's ciphered mémoires of 26 and 27 March 1649, probably to Noirmoutier, BnF fr. 3854 nos. 41-42

steps.what: Found nos. 41-42 already deciphered by Lasry (HistoCrypt 2023); established that no. 43 is a different numeric code, not a crib.
Checked Lasry's key against a hand copy of his Figure 8: 234 of 237 pairs fit.
Transcribed nos. 41-42 from the images independently.
Decoded nos. 41-42 with the published key; agrees with Lasry, small corrections added.

Split from the former combined target (catalogue 26, nos. 41-43) under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): nos. 41-42 (Lasry's poly-homophonic letter cipher) keep conti1649; no. 43 (numeric letter-and-syllable code, key rebuilt from its glosses) is now laigue1649. Earlier steps kept as recorded; nos. 41-42 measured: 1,689 of 1,692 cipher signs have a value (99.8%).

outcome.method_basis: Nos. 41-42 were transcribed afresh from the images and decrypted with Lasry's published key (HistoCrypt 2023), whose reading was in hand before the attempt; the text agrees with his, with three small corrections.
outcome.notes: Nos. 41-42 re-decrypted from a fresh transcription with Lasry's key; three corrections to his printed text. Tenerande unidentified; 'dix'/'six mil hommes' open (polyphonic m). No. 43 split off to laigue1649.

credits.note: nos. 41-42 deciphered, text and key printed, HistoCrypt 2023
his key applied to a fresh transcription of nos. 41-42

outcome.fraction_read_source: targets/conti1649/measure_4142.py on transcription.txt: cipher signs outside the clear words; '?' counts as unread

prior.where: Lasry, HistoCrypt 2023 (full text and key of nos. 41-42)

human: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.
